name: n8n-code-javascript

Choose "Run Once for All Items" mode (recommended for most use cases). Access data: `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, or `$input.item`. Must return `[{json: {...}}]` format. Webhook data is under `$json.body` (not `$json` directly). Built-ins: `$helpers.httpRequest()`, DateTime (Luxon), `$jmespath()`.

Use All Items for aggregation/filtering/batches/transformations/API calls/comparisons; Each Item only for independent logic; unsure → All Items. Use `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, `$input.item`, or `$node["Webhook"].json`. Webhook data is nested under `.body`. **MOST COMMON MISTAKE**: Webhook data is nested under `.body`. **See**: [DATA_ACCESS.
